note: 11A grid probe A7b, and a case whose divergence is the ORACLE SHIM'S, not kg's -- read the phase11-one-arg-defvar-file-scope row, rewritten at Phase 12's pin. A one-argument `(defvar ov)' makes ov let-dynamic even though special-variable-p answers nil for it, and that effect is scoped to the reader/evaluation unit the defvar appeared in. Emacs' shim evaluates each setup form with its own `(eval FORM t)', which is a separate unit each time, so the defvar's effect does not reach the expression and Emacs answers (void-variable ov). kg's runner concatenates setup and expr into one file and runs it as one unit, so kg answers 5 -- and so does Emacs for the same three forms as one lexical-binding: t file, measured on 31.0.90. The case therefore stays `divergent' after Phase 12 gave fe a real per-unit scope carrier; what closed the leak is measured by the two-file probe test_phase12_one_arg_defvar_file_scope instead. phase11-dynamic-one-arg-defvar-not-special is the arity's other half, and agrees on both sides.
